clips.title: The story
paras: Harvesting Windstones is a task offered by Dalia the Collector in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. As the ancient elemental energies sustaining the island slowly fade, raw windstones have become an essential magical fuel source. Adventurers are sent across the grove to harvest crystalline windstone clusters before their power is lost.

Zephras Isle relies heavily on lingering wind magic to sustain itself, but its natural defenses are dwindling. Centuries ago, the native wind elementals who shared the island with the local elves vanished entirely. Since their departure, the ambient magic upholding the land and the great anchor pylons has been in a slow, steady decline. For the residents of Thendal Grove, surviving this depletion requires securing every possible reserve of raw energy.

Windstones are vibrant blue crystalline formations scattered naturally throughout Thendal Grove. Within their brittle shells lies dense, concentrated wind magic left behind from ages past. While not an endless solution, they provide a reliable and invaluable source of arcane sustenance and utility for the island's elves, making the collection of raw clusters a vital daily endeavor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on zephras with us vanished several centuries ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.
You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove, think you can help me harvest them?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade.
Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.
